parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range when event traces are queried. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: EventBusName
parameters.description: The name of the event bus.

parameters.name: EventSource
parameters.description: The name of the event source.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to return in a request. You can use this parameter and NextToken to implement paging.

>  A maximum of 100 entries can be returned in a request.

parameters.name: MatchedRule
parameters.description: The name of the event rule that is matched.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: If you configure Limit and excess return values exist, this parameter is returned.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query event traces. Unit: milliseconds.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eventbridge query-traced-events --event-bus-name MyEventBus --start-time 1661773509000 --end-time 1661773509000 --limit 50 --next-token 1000 --event-source mse --subject example-string --event-type eventbridge:Events:HTTPEvent --matched-rule test-mnsrule --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eventbridge QueryTracedEvents --region cn-hangzhou --EventBusName MyEventBus --EventSource mse --EndTime 1661773509000 --NextToken 1000 --EventType 'eventbridge:Events:HTTPEvent' --StartTime 1661773509000 --Limit 50 --Subject 'example-string' --MatchedRule 'test-mnsrule'
